annotation.title_clean: Silicon tiger: Korea unleashes strategy to rise as AI superpower
annotation.title_en: Silicon tiger: Korea unleashes strategy to rise as AI superpower
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (Korea Here & Now)
annotation.summary_en: Government news feature on Korea's creation of the Presidential National Artificial Intelligence Committee, approved by Cabinet on July 30, 2024. It describes the committee's public-private "one team" mandate to coordinate AI strategy, investment, infrastructure, regulation and ethics. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Cabinet approved a Presidential Decree proposal establishing the National AI Committee on July 30, 2024
Committee coordinates national AI policy, R&D, investment, data centers and regulatory improvement
Committee brings together industry, academia and government members
Committee is to promote ethical principles in AI and respond to impacts on education and labor
Context: April AI-Semiconductor Initiative and May AI Seoul Summit
